request.query: Finsupp extending a function along an embedding and updating outside its range is adding a singleton

items.name: Finsupp.update_eq_erase_add_single
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {M : Type u_3} [inst : AddZeroClass M] (f : ι →₀ M) (a : ι) (b : M),
  f.update a b = Finsupp.erase a f + Finsupp.single a b
